headline: Two SLA functions added to XQL; Gemini 3.5 Flash extended to the CA and DE regions
summary_md:
- **Cortex XQL Command Reference** gained two case-SLA functions, `is_sla_breached` and `sla_time_remaining`, taking the book from 184 to 186 pages.
- The **Agentic AI** page adds CA and DE to the regions running Gemini 3.5 Flash.
- Data Model Rules drops its notice restricting access to Account and Instance Administrators; the View/Edit RBAC requirement for Data Management remains.
- The XSIAM configuration landing page is renamed and rewritten from a paragraph into a linked index of configuration areas.
- The five playbook pages are a copy-edit pass: bold pseudo-headings become real headings, and the truncated "Playbook development checkli" title is repaired.

highlights.title: XQL adds is_sla_breached() and sla_time_remaining() for querying case SLAs
highlights.detail: Both read an SLA field from the cases dataset (or a custom_fields SLA), exclude paused time, and work in the filter, sort and comp stages — one returning a boolean breach flag, the other the seconds remaining as a signed integer.

highlights.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash now listed for the CA and DE regions
highlights.detail: The sentence naming the regions without the model selector changes from "SG, JP, IN, and UK" to "SG, JP, IN, UK, CA, and DE".

highlights.title: Data Model Rules no longer states that only Account or Instance Administrators can access it
highlights.detail: The whole notice was deleted; the page's remaining access statement is the View/Edit RBAC permission for Data Management, unchanged.

highlights.title: "Learn how to configure Cortex XSIAM" is renamed "Configure Cortex XSIAM"
highlights.detail: The page is rewritten from one paragraph into a three-step sequence plus a linked index grouped as data and connectivity, AI and automation, and operations and governance; the navigation manifest carries the new title.

highlights.title: "Playbook development checkli" is now "Playbook development checklist"
highlights.detail: A truncated page title fixed in both the page and the XSIAM navigation tree.

items.xql/readme/functions/is_sla_breached: New page: returns true/false/NULL for whether an SLA passed its goal, with four examples covering flagging, filtering, counting by severity and custom SLAs.
items.xql/readme/functions/sla_time_remaining: New page: returns seconds until breach, negative once breached, and is usable with percentile, median, avg, min and max.
items.xql/readme/functions/functions-list: Both new SLA functions added to the master function table.
items.xsiam/learn-about-cortex-xsiam/agentic-a: CA and DE join SG, JP, IN and UK as regions running Gemini 3.5 Flash.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/data-manage: Drops the Account/Instance Administrator access notice; also fixes "quarriable" to "queryable" and "transitions" to "transformations".
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/configure-c: Renamed to "Configure Cortex XSIAM" and rebuilt as a linked index of the configuration areas, with a suggested ordering.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/automations: Page title un-truncated to "Playbook development checklist".
The RBAC ordering note loses its "Prerequisite" heading and its stray bullet; the required order of Scripts then Playbooks is unchanged.
Bold pseudo-headings become H3 headings named for the task; wording only otherwise.
Same heading pass, plus a corrected "out-of-the-box" hyphenation.
"least-privileged" corrected to "least-privilege"; the access-roles list is promoted to a heading.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/data-manage: Reformatting: the three CU query types are bolded and two raw HTML hint blocks are rewritten, one as a plain link. CU rates are unchanged.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/marketplace: The four support-type headings are renamed to spell out "Marketplace content packs"; the support terms themselves are unchanged.
One heading renamed to "Pre-installed Cortex XSIAM Marketplace content packs".
items.compatibility/where-can-i-install-the-co: Trailing blank lines only — no change to the tested Kubernetes platforms or versions.
